fields.name: Karmetī (Karametivai Mātā)
fields.place: Born at Khajal («South India» in the record); Vṛndāvana (by Brahma-kuṇḍa; her hut)
fields.notes: Daughter of Paraśurāma Paṇḍita, priest of a royal family of Khajal. Left a husband who was no Vaiṣṇava, fled to Vṛndāvana hiding three days in a camel's carcass, and lived in ecstatic meditation by Brahma-kuṇḍa; refused her father's pleas to come home; the king had a hut built for her there. Her sampradāya is not named.

fields.aka: Ṭoṭā Ramdasa bābājī, Rāmadāsa Miśra (birth name)
fields.disappearance: The tenth day of the bright fortnight of Pauṣa (the record: «the tenth day of the full moon in Pauṣa»)
fields.place: Navadvīpa (under the peepal trees by the Gaṅgā; Baḍa Ākhaḍā; Mahāprabhu's temple); Vṛndāvana (ṭhaurā south of the Gopīnātha temple)
fields.notes: Born Rāmadāsa Miśra, a Drāviḍa brāhmaṇa; left his Nyāya studies in Navadvīpa for bhajana in Vṛndāvana, and came back by Mahāprabhu's order to look after His Deity's service; head of the Vaiṣṇavas of Navadvīpa. Mahārāja Kṛṣṇacandra gave him the title «Ṭoṭā» and six acres of tax-free land (Baḍa Ākhaḍā, run by his disciples' descendants; deed of 1202 BS / 1785); he served Śrī Giridhārī and had Mahāprabhu's temple rebuilt. His guru is not named.

fields.name: Śiśu Ananta (Pañcasakhā)
fields.appearance: 1486, at Balipatna (Purī), in the 25th year of King Puruṣottamadeva (Acyutānanda's Udaya-kāhānī)
fields.place: Born at Balipatna (Purī district); Koṇārka (met Lord Caitanya); Purī
fields.guru: Nityānanda Prabhu, at Lord Caitanya's order (Īśvara dāsa's Caitanya-bhāgavata)
fields.works: Udebākhāṇa (published); in manuscript: Garuḍa-Ananta-saṁvāda, Agata-cumbaka-mālikā, Hetu-udaya-bhāgavata, Udebākhara, Chatabākhara, Ṭhikā-bākhara stotra, a cautiśā, bhajanas; a «Bhaviṣya Purāṇa»
fields.notes: The youngest of the Oṛiyā Pañcasakhās, founder of the Śiśu-sampradāya (born 1486 at Balipatna). Called «Śiśu» after becoming the child Pradyumna before Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa (Īśvara dāsa). Met Lord Caitanya at Koṇārka, who had Nityānanda give him the mahā-mantra. Dāma in Kṛṣṇa-līlā (Īśvara dāsa).
